title: Georgetown Taiwanese Student Association
content_html:
The Georgetown Taiwanese Student Association (GUTSA) was a student organization at Georgetown University that served students from Taiwan. A former vice president’s personal website (dated April 2012) documents the organization as active during the 2011–2012 academic year, describing its purpose as advocating for Taiwanese culture through educational, social, and cultural activities within the Georgetown community. GUTSA also aimed to maintain connections with alumni worldwide and to build relationships with other Taiwanese student organizations.

Documented activities from that period included organizing welcome receptions for incoming Taiwanese students, hosting cultural festivals such as the Mid-Autumn Festival and Lantern Festival, and maintaining a communication link between Taiwanese students and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office (TECRO). GUTSA does not appear in Georgetown’s current official student organization directory, and no first-party web presence (website, Instagram, Facebook, or Linktree) has been identified as of 2026.
